summary: Exemplary test suite spanning unit, structure, and end-to-end acceptance layers. Unit tests (test_matrix_generator.py) comprehensively cover cartesian products, exclude/include algorithms (including GitHub's documented example), config validation, and CLI with all error paths (missing files, invalid JSON, strict mode exit codes). Structure tests validate workflow YAML, triggers, permissions, actionlint compliance, and script/fixture paths. Acceptance tests (test_workflow_act.py) parametrize 5 fixtures across the real GitHub Actions workflow via act, with exact value matching (size, combinations, job success counts) rather than fuzzy assertions. Edge cases thoroughly covered: empty axes, oversized matrices, partial-match excludes, include merging logic, standalone entry handling, boundary conditions. Test organization is clear with documented cycles matching TDD methodology. Fixtures use known-good EXPECTED dictionary enabling precise regression detection. Test independence and isolation excellent (per-fixture git repos, ANSI stripping, output delimiters). Would reliably catch regressions across config parsing, matrix generation, CLI behavior, and workflow integration.
